WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.anlycount) as pair_avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON sf.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  WHERE sf.anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sf.transref, tr.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg_anlycount) as overall_mean
  FROM pair_averages
),
pairs_with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.transref,
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.pair_avg_anlycount,
    (pa.pair_avg_anlycount - om.overall_mean) as amount_above_mean
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.pair_avg_anlycount > om.overall_mean
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pwd.tradekind,
    AVG(pwd.pair_avg_anlycount) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(pwd.amount_above_mean) as avg_amount_above_mean
  FROM pairs_with_diff pwd
  GROUP BY pwd.tradekind
),
cross_trader_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount_above_mean) as cross_trader_mean
  FROM trader_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  tts.tradekind,
  tts.avg_analyst_count,
  tts.avg_amount_above_mean,
  tts.avg_analyst_count / ctm.cross_trader_mean as ratio
FROM trader_type_stats tts
CROSS JOIN cross_trader_mean ctm
ORDER BY tts.tradekind
